name: Core i7-1260P
memory: DDR5-4800, DDR4-3200, LPDDR5-5200, LPDDR4X-4267, dual-channel, up to 64 GB

passmark.mapping_note: CPU: exact entry. GPU: PassMark pools every 'Intel Iris Xe' iGPU (80 and 96 EU, many chips) under one entry; there is no per-SKU entry.

notes: igpu.cu counts the 96 EU as 6 subslices of 16 EU (the Xe-LP equivalent of an Xe-core). base_ghz is the P-core base from TPU (E-core 1.5 GHz). ARK lists no NPU, so npu_tops is 0. launch_date from TPU; ARK says Q1'22. Intel tdp_w: default = Processor Base Power, min = Minimum Assured Power, max = Maximum Turbo Power (PL2); PL2 is not comparable to an AMD cTDP maximum. igpu.tflops_fp32 = shaders x 2 FLOP x vendor max GPU clock (single-issue FMA; RDNA 3 dual-issue is not counted). PassMark scores mix TDPs and host devices; treat them as a rough guide only.
